name: Windshear Crag
summary: In central Stonetalon, Windshear Crag lies scarred by the Venture Company's logging. The old forest is gone, replaced by machinery, muddy runoff, and logging crews. Kobolds dig for ore nearby, while a mountain passage leads beneath the ridges to Ashenvale.

sections.title: Industrial Devastation
sections.body: Windshear Crag's old forest is gone, cut down by the Venture Company for profit. Stumps and machinery now fill the basin. Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, a leper gnome, oversees the logging from a platform above Cragpool Lake. His engineering gave the company the Super Reaper 6000, which fells great trees in moments. The operation strips the mountain bare, stirring anger among rival engineers and local inhabitants alike.

sections.title: Mines and Mountain Passes
sections.body: Windshear Crag's timberyards are not its only danger or crossroads. In the southeast, kobolds dig through Windshear Mine for Smoky Iron Ingots and attack those who approach their haul. The Talondeep Path runs beneath the ridges from the crag's northeast reaches into Ashenvale. Near its entrance, the tauren elder Braug Dimspirit tests the historical wisdom and resolve of Horde travelers crossing the contested peaks.

faq.q: Who is running the logging operation here?
aliases: who is the boss of windshear
faq.answer: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle directs the logging operation at Windshear Crag. The brilliant leper gnome engineer works under contract with the Venture Company and watches over the crag from a timber platform above Cragpool Lake.

Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle built the Super Reaper 6000, a mechanical logging prototype. It clears timber at great speed, grinding ancient mountain trees into sawdust within moments and hastening the company's clear-cutting.

faq.q: Why is the Undermine Tinkers' Union targeting Gerenzo?
faq.answer: Director Riddlevox of Undermine's Tinkers' Union wants Gerenzo dead. Ziz Fizziks, a goblin who helped steal the Super Reaper 6000 blueprints, carries out the order. Undermine's trade princes disapprove of the Venture Company consorting with the gnome.

faq.q: Where does the cave in the northeast lead?
faq.answer: The cave in the northeast is the Talondeep Path. It runs beneath the mountain roots, connecting Windshear Crag and Ashenvale by foot.

faq.q: Who are the kobolds digging in the southeast?
faq.answer: Windshear kobolds have overrun the mine in the crag's southeast. They defend their claim as they dig for Smoky Iron Ingots, which regional smiths use.

angles.text: The machinery across Windshear Crag reveals goblin trade secrets and Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle's lethal Super Reaper designs.
On the way to Ashenvale, Horde travelers meet Braug Dimspirit near the Talondeep Path. He tests their knowledge of Kalimdor's history.
